prompt: On the canvas, the number keys should set the opacity of the selected layers: 1 sets 10%, 2 sets 20% and so on up to 9 for 90%, and 0 sets 100%. Each press is one step to undo. The keys only work while the canvas has focus, and do nothing when nothing is selected.
reference: Each key commits the percentage through the Opacity field, which sets a group's own opacity.

naive.summary: Follows Proof: groups carry no opacity, so a group's value is written to every styled layer inside it and the group itself is left alone.
